title: NISM Equity Derivatives (Series VIII)
blurb: Exam prep for NISM-Series-VIII: futures, options, pricing, Greeks, strategies, margins, clearing, settlement, regulation and risk.

rows: Dealers, advisers, RMs and anyone preparing for NISM-Series-VIII
About 128 minutes of lessons, then cards, checkpoints and the final quiz
None. Basic equity market knowledge helps
20 short lessons in 6 stages, each ending with three exam-style checks
outcomes: Explain forwards, futures and options and compute their payoffs.
Price futures with cost of carry and explain what drives option premiums.
Use the Greeks and build common option strategies.
Describe margining, mark-to-market, clearing and settlement.
Apply the regulatory and risk-management rules for derivatives dealing.

sources: NISM-Series-VIII: Equity Derivatives Certification Examination workbook (current edition)
SEBI circulars on derivatives segment: contract specifications, margins, position limits, risk disclosure
NSE and BSE derivatives contract specifications (lot sizes and expiries change: always check the current circulars)
Practice exam only: confirm the current NISM exam format before booking
